source: One capture of espresense/devices/# + espresense/companion/# from plackettsj1's home, posted by him on https://github.com/ESPresense/ESPresense/issues/2220 on 2026-11-25 (capture.txt + config.txt). Companion 2.6.8, firmware per his nodes. His config has locators.nadaraya_watson + locators.nearest_node enabled and NO locators.multi_floor: this is the pre-fix configuration #2220 was filed against. Geometry, node positions and room polygons are his config.txt verbatim; he redacted broker and GPS himself.

capture.timestampResolution: 1s (mosquitto_sub -F '%I'); t is whole seconds from tZero
capture.ordering: reports[] and readings[] are in capture (wire) order. Because timestamps are only second-resolution, pair by array order, never by t.

beacons.label: Green
beacons.truthSource: reporter, on-thread: "When I captured the data the Green Beacon was in the Sitting Room all of the time."
beacons.note: Canonical. The only beacon in this capture with a reporter-stated room.

beacons.label: Yellow
beacons.note: Secondary. Reporter-named as the beacon that was always wrong when he tested locators.multi_floor, so it is the series to watch in a multi_floor arm.

beacons.label: Blue
beacons.note: Reference only: no reporter-stated room for this capture.

beacons.label: Orange
beacons.note: Reference only: no reporter-stated room for this capture. Tightest input-side ranges of the four (kitchen3 sd 0.02 m at 0.72 m).

nodeFloorsNote: All 21 nodes list all three floors, exactly as configured. This is load-bearing: it is why every per-floor scenario solves with nodes a storey or two away and why the winning scenario oscillates. A fixture with one floor per node does not reproduce #2220.
readingsNote: rssi / refRssi (the tag's advertised rssi@1m) / rxAdj are the inputs; derive distance with the companion's own pipeline. dist and distVar are the node's own numbers, carried for provenance only - no assertion may read them. The per-node converged absorption / rx_adj_rssi / tx_ref_rssi in effect at capture time was not captured, so a replay is not bit-reproducible; see README.
